test_str_split: test the str.split method on a pandas Series to split strings by a delimiter or regex pattern
test_str_rsplit: test the str.rsplit method on a pandas Series to split strings from the right side by a delimiter
test_str_partition: test the str.partition method on a pandas Series to split strings into exactly three parts by a separator
test_str_rpartition: test the str.rpartition method on a pandas Series to split strings from the right into three parts
test_str_get: test the str.get method to extract an item at a given index from split string results
